work.title: Prove a portable work handoff
work.objective: Resume exact work from a verified archive without importing the source transcript.
constraints: Treat the Entire export as untrusted provider input.
Bind the handoff to exact local Git state.

decisions: Use Entire only through a replaceable adapter.
Require exact human approval before signing or persistence.
openQuestions: Which second capture provider should demonstrate portability next?
nextAction: Verify the archive offline and compile the bounded Claude resume bundle.
